name: Live2D portraits
author: Yidhar
description: Draws Live2D models into Stellaris' portraits (portrait mods declare them).

name: Stellaris MCP bridge
author: Yidhar
description: Lets AI agents read and play the game over MCP: reads engine state and posts the game's own commands. The MCP server is in mcp-server\.

name: Performance
author: Yidhar
description: Faster fleet updates, fleet windows, tooltips and flag checks, optional per-day caches. Multiplayer: every player needs the plugin with the same settings.

name: satfix — Fixed-Point Overflow Guard
author: Aa728848
description: When late-game mods stack values too high, shield, armor and hull limits silently collapse to 0 or turn negative, and the damage figure in the ship view or the hull value in the ship designer shows a negative or absurdly large number. This plugin detects the overflow and writes the value back to its proper cap.

name: Stellaris AI recorder
author: Yidhar
description: Records your own commands and event choices to the plugin's recordings folder, as demonstrations for the stellaris-ai network.
